title: Original Research
description: Your stipend comes out of an endowment, and the patron wants to see it produce something before winter. Choose a specialization and put something on paper I can defend. If there is nothing, the money goes elsewhere.

objectives.description: Tell Elara which specialization you will be judged on
objectives.notes: Dialogue choice: Elemental, Illusion, Necromancy, or Enchantment

objectives.description: Gather ten measures of arcane essence
Run five experiments in the research laboratory
Defend the thesis before the council

notes: Threat: an endowment that lapses to someone else if the research produces nothing. Giver motive: Elara has to justify every Journeyman's upkeep to the patron paying for it, at a council session where other Magisters are watching her choices. Consequence: unwired - the quest cannot fail or produce a weak thesis in the data, so the endowment never actually moves. First Journeyman quest; reward depends on chosen specialization. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
